question: In the United States, for Q4 2019 and Q4 2020, first select only those cities where total sales (with no promotions) rose by at least 20% from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020. Among these cities, rank products by their overall sales (still excluding promotions) in those quarters and take the top 20%. Then compute each top product’s share of total sales in Q4 2019 and Q4 2020 and calculate the difference in share from Q4 2019 to Q4 2020, returning the results in descending order of that share change.
sql:
WITH city_sales AS (
    SELECT c.cust_city,
           t.calendar_quarter_desc,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
    GROUP BY c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
city_pivot AS (
    SELECT cust_city,
           MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04' THEN total_sales END) as sales_q4_2019,
           MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04' THEN total_sales END) as sales_q4_2020
    FROM city_sales
    GROUP BY cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT cust_city
    FROM city_pivot
    WHERE sales_q4_2019 > 0
      AND sales_q4_2020 >= sales_q4_2019 * 1.2
),
prod_city_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           c.cust_city,
           t.calendar_quarter_desc,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as prod_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, c.cust_city, t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
prod_total_sales AS (
    SELECT prod_id,
           SUM(prod_sales) as total_prod_sales
    FROM prod_city_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id, total_prod_sales,
           NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY total_prod_sales DESC) as tile
    FROM prod_total_sales
),
top_products AS (
    SELECT prod_id
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE tile = 1
),
quarter_totals AS (
    SELECT t.calendar_quarter_desc,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
      AND s.promo_id = 999
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND t.calendar_quarter_number = 4
      AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    GROUP BY t.calendar_quarter_desc
),
prod_share AS (
    SELECT pcs.prod_id,
           pcs.calendar_quarter_desc,
           pcs.prod_sales,
           qt.total_sales,
           pcs.prod_sales * 1.0 / qt.total_sales as share
    FROM prod_city_sales pcs
    JOIN quarter_totals qt ON pcs.calendar_quarter_desc = qt.calendar_quarter_desc
    WHERE pcs.prod_id IN (SELECT prod_id FROM top_products)
),
product_quarters AS (
    SELECT prod_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = '2019-04' THEN share END) as share_q4_2019,
           MAX(CASE WHEN calendar_quarter_desc = '2020-04' THEN share END) as share_q4_2020
    FROM prod_share
    GROUP BY prod_id
)
SELECT prod_id,
       share_q4_2019,
       share_q4_2020,
       share_q4_2020 - share_q4_2019 as share_change
FROM product_quarters
ORDER BY share_change DESC
